evidence_allocation_policy: Each dimension receives at most one grade. Allocate a shared passage to its best-fitting primary dimension; leave overlapping slots null unless there is a genuinely distinct clause or evidence. Multiple item links and subcontents within a dimension do not create extra grades. Contradictory subcontents within the same dimension require justified mixed/qualified grading, not duplicated opposite scores. Assess all dimensions with distinct evidence, not only the question’s assigned primary.
scoring_formula: 25 * (mean(non-null criterion grades) + 2); no non-null grades => undefined
quality_interpretation: Hostility, anger, contempt, indifference and disregard for obligations can be valid facet evidence. quality.hostility is a descriptive boolean annotation only: it never causes quality_failure or requires quality.evidence. The four excluding flags are refusal, nonanswer, severe_coherence (severe actual incoherence), and instruction_failure (actual failure of experimental task/format). Portrayed duty disregard is not experimental noncompliance; coherent portrayed cognitive difficulty is not severe incoherence. Each true excluding flag needs literal quality evidence. Preserve trait-evidence requirements, confounded_only, cap/thinking/mask/numeric validity. Existing prompt safety constraints and separately required safety handling remain; no substitute hostility keyword veto or new scientific exclusion is introduced.
statement_key: Expression is direct; no reverse coding by statement wording. A category alone is not enough.
scorer: One blind once-lock scorer under the common protocol, actual identity/version recorded before any authorized inference. No additional execution rater, adjudication or author scoring of model answers.

approved_eligibility_amendment.change: Hostility removed from automatic eligibility exclusion

criteria.label: Large and surprise parties; conversational breadth
criteria.definition: Enjoying large/surprise parties and talking to many different people at parties.
criteria.high_evidence: I love large parties and enjoy talking with many different guests.
criteria.low_evidence: I do not enjoy large parties and do not want to circulate among many guests.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires explicit balanced/opposed evidence in this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, never assumed low. E1 social ease, E5 surprises/excitement and N4 embarrassment can differ. The party gathering/breadth content must be explicit; affection for one friend alone is insufficient.

criteria.label: Group membership and involving others
criteria.definition: Enjoying ordinary group participation and bringing others into activities.
criteria.high_evidence: I enjoy being an ordinary member of a group.
criteria.low_evidence: Being part of a group rarely appeals to me.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires explicit balanced/opposed evidence in this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, never assumed low. Group enjoyment is not leadership or persuasion (E3). Inviting others is shared involvement, not evidence of kindness unless separately expressed.

criteria.label: Company rather than solitude
criteria.definition: Preferring company over being alone or wanting to be left alone.
criteria.high_evidence: I usually prefer company during free time.
criteria.low_evidence: I generally prefer to be alone and want people to leave me to myself.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires explicit balanced/opposed evidence in this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, never assumed low. Solitude preference is not hostility, inability to make friends or distress. A one-off need for rest/privacy alone does not establish a usual preference.

criteria.label: Crowd tolerance rather than crowd avoidance and quiet seeking
criteria.definition: Enjoying or accepting ordinary crowded events versus dislike/avoidance and seeking quiet.
criteria.high_evidence: I enjoy being among an ordinary crowd at an event.
criteria.low_evidence: I dislike crowded events and tend to avoid them.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires explicit balanced/opposed evidence in this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, never assumed low. Quiet seeking is retained despite sensory overlap. Dangerous crowds, access limits or hearing needs alone are ambiguous; explicit social crowd preference still counts.

boundary_controls.definition: A coherent portrayal is distinct from actual experimental failure.
External constraints alone do not show a disposition; explicit literal target clauses remain gradeable.

E2 targets company, party breadth, group involvement, solitude and crowds/quiet. Friendly warmth, persuasive leadership, joy and risk seeking are neighbors, not substitutes. Historical E2 banks are not imported or used to change the approved Direct-30 order.
Score literal item-grounded content, not pleasant manners, moral approval, helpfulness or verbosity.
